Seer.directive_rationale: Your decision to claim early and provide data... forced the wolves to react.
Seer.actual_player_behavior: Jin revealed they were the Seer and provided data (Nhan is innocent) during the voting phase of Round 1.
Seer.verdict_notes: Jin revealed their role and data in Round 1, although it occurred during the vote rather than the debate phase.

Seer.directive_trigger: any player claims your data is 'unverifiable'
Seer.directive_rationale: any player who claims your data is 'unverifiable' is likely a wolf attempting to paralyze the village.
Seer.verdict_notes: No player claimed the Seer's data was 'unverifiable'.

Guard.directive_rationale: The Seer is the village's only source of objective truth; you must prioritize their survival above all else.
Guard.actual_player_behavior: Hoang protected Nhan instead of the Seer (Jin).
Guard.verdict_notes: Hoang did not protect the Seer; they protected the Witch.

Witch.directive_rationale: Your use of the Save potion on the Seer in Round 2 was the turning point of the game.
Witch.verdict_notes: The Seer was not attacked by wolves; the Seer was eliminated by the Witch's poison.

Witch.directive_trigger: player shows 'Confusion Masks' (stalling/vague excuses) AND seer_is_unavailable
Witch.directive_rationale: do not hesitate to use your Poison potion on players showing 'Confusion Masks' (stalling/vague excuses) if the Seer is unavailable.
Witch.verdict_notes: The trigger requires the Seer to be unavailable; however, the Witch used the poison on the Seer himself while he was still alive.

Villager.directive_rationale: Continue this 'Role-Call Enforcement' to trap wolves in contradictions.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Nam (Villager) stated, 'Nhan is correct; we need a role call immediately.' Cong (Villager) stated, 'We don't need to "let the Seer speak naturally"—we need facts.'
Villager.verdict_notes: Both Villagers actively requested and supported a role call in Round 1.

Villager.directive_trigger: conflict between Seer-cleared player and uncleared player's intuition
Villager.directive_rationale: Always prioritize Seer-cleared players over the 'intuition' of uncleared players.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Nhan (cleared by Seer Jin) was accused by Meg (uncleared) of being too aggressive. Nam and Cong voted to exile Meg.
Villager.verdict_notes: The Villagers prioritized the cleared player (Nhan) and voted against the uncleared player (Meg) who was attacking Nhan.
